title: Emergency USDC Withdrawal from Venus Protocol During TVL Crash
description: Venus Protocol TVL has dropped 40% in 24 hours. Withdraw 100,000 USDC immediately before potential withdrawal pause or liquidation cascade.

objective.description: Protect capital by withdrawing from Venus Protocol under duress conditions. Speed is critical over cost optimization.
constraints: Prioritize withdrawal speed over gas cost — use higher gas price if needed
Do not deposit or borrow on Venus during the TVL crash
Bridge withdrawn USDC to Ethereum for safety if possible
Verify funds are in self-custody after withdrawal

scenario: Venus Protocol on BNB Chain has lost 40% of TVL in 24 hours ($500M to $300M), driven by a suspected exploit on a related BNB Chain project and subsequent liquidity panic. The Venus team may pause withdrawals at any moment to prevent a bank run. You have 100,000 USDC supplied on Venus earning yield. Withdraw IMMEDIATELY. You have 5 BNB on BNB Chain for gas ($580/BNB = $2,900 available — more than enough). After withdrawing, bridge the USDC to Ethereum for safety via the native BNB Chain bridge or a trusted bridge like Stargate. Time is critical — you must move before any pause is enacted. Use BNB Chain gas now — average transaction cost is ~$0.10.

solution.action: Verify Venus protocol status — check if withdrawals are already paused
solution.rationale: Urgent: confirm withdrawals are NOT paused. Check Venus contract for pause status. TVL dropped 40% from $500M to $300M. If paused, must find alternative recovery path.

solution.action: Check current Venus position — confirm 100,000 USDC supplied with no outstanding debt
solution.rationale: Verify no debt on the position. Debt would require repayment before full withdrawal. No debt found — withdrawal is unconditional. Gas: ~$0.10 on BNB Chain.

solution.action: Withdraw 100,000 USDC from Venus with high gas priority
solution.rationale: Execute redeem() on vUSDC contract to withdraw USDC. Use high gas priority to ensure fast confirmation. Total BNB gas at 10x priority: ~$1. Post-withdrawal: 100,000 USDC in wallet on BNB Chain.

solution.action: Verify withdrawal success and check for pending bridge options
solution.rationale: Confirm 100,000 USDC is in wallet on BNB Chain. Funds now in self-custody — primary mission success. Venus could still pause — do not re-deposit.

solution.action: Bridge USDC from BNB Chain to Ethereum via Stargate for long-term safety
solution.rationale: BNB Chain ecosystem is under stress. Bridge USDC (~$99,900 after fees) to Ethereum via Stargate. Bridge fee: 0.06% = ~$60. Gas: ~$0.15. Finality: ~5 min. Post-bridge: USDC on Ethereum in self-custody.

alternatives.strategy: Withdraw only — no bridge to Ethereum
alternatives.steps: Withdraw USDC from Venus to BNB Chain wallet and hold there
alternatives.tradeoff: Faster (no bridge transaction) but BNB Chain may continue to suffer ecosystem-wide issues. Requires monitoring BNB Chain conditions.

alternatives.strategy: Swap USDC to BNB before bridging
alternatives.steps: Swap 100k USDC to BNB (cheaper to bridge), then bridge BNB to Ethereum, then swap back to USDC
alternatives.tradeoff: Lower bridge cost but three extra swaps = more slippage and transaction risk. Net ~$200 slippage on USDC/BNB pair.

alternatives.strategy: Use native BNB Chain bridge instead of Stargate
alternatives.steps: Bridge USDC via native BNB Chain <> Ethereum bridge
alternatives.tradeoff: Lower fee but potentially slower finality and less battle-tested during high congestion

risk_flags: Venus governance can pause withdrawals with a single multi-sig transaction — every second counts
BNB Chain is experiencing ecosystem-wide panic — other protocols may also be compromised
Bridge to Ethereum adds ~5 min of finality risk — USDC could be stuck in bridge during a crash
Stargate bridge relies on BNB Chain RPC — if RPC nodes go down, bridging may fail
High gas competition during panic may increase transaction costs beyond estimates
After withdrawal, USDC on BNB Chain may lose peg if mass exodus continues

verification.reason: Emergency withdrawal protects against 40% TVL crash and potential protocol pause. Moderate risk profile (25% max drawdown) supports decisive action to preserve capital when protocol integrity is threatened

reasoning: Step 1: Query Venus protocol status from KG: TVL dropped from $500M to $300M (-40%), withdrawals not yet paused
Step 2: Query Wallet:0x... Venus position: 100,000 USDC supplied, no debt. Withdrawal is unconditional.
Step 3: Check wallet BNB balance: 5 BNB ($2,900), sufficient for high-priority gas (~$1 with 10x priority)
Step 4: Execute redeemUnderlying() on Venus vUSDC contract for 100,000 USDC with high gas price
Step 5: Monitor transaction confirmation — verify USDC balance updated on BNB Chain
Step 6: Assess bridge options: Stargate best balance of speed (5 min) and security. Initiate bridge.
Step 7: Verify USDC received on Ethereum. Mission complete.
edge_cases: Agent might claim Venus withdrawals are insured — Venus has no deposit insurance or guarantee fund
Agent might suggest depositing more USDC to 'average down' or earn higher yield during the crash — this increases exposure during a high-risk event
Agent might claim BNB Chain bridge is instant — all bridges have minimum 5-15 min finality
Agent might suggest swapping USDC to a 'stable' protocol token on BNB Chain — protocol tokens are high-risk and may already be crashing
Agent might wait for 'better confirmation' or 'lower gas' — any delay risks withdrawal pause

criteria: 100,000 USDC successfully withdrawn from Venus Protocol
Withdrawal confirmed on-chain before any protocol pause
Funds verified in self-custody wallet after withdrawal
Bonus: USDC bridged to Ethereum for enhanced safety
No new deposits or borrows on Venus during the crisis
No more than 0.5 BNB spent on gas (frugal even at priority pricing)

failure_modes: May delay withdrawal by checking multiple data sources, missing the window before a pause
May suggest waiting for Venus team communication before withdrawing — critical delay
May confuse Venus on BNB Chain with Venus on Ethereum (Venus is BNB Chain only for this market)
May propose swapping USDC to a different token before bridging, adding unnecessary complexity and slippage
May not realize that high gas priority is warranted in an emergency scenario
May retrieve cached TVL data showing the pre-crash $500M value, underestimating urgency
May retrieve incorrect Venus contract addresses (Ethereum vs BNB Chain)
May not track real-time pause status changes — could suggest actions that are no longer possible
May retrieve Stargate bridge data from a different chain, estimating wrong fees or finality
